description: Settings for the internal Employee Chat

fields.description: Archive a chat about a document once it has been quiet for long enough. Archived document chats become read-only.
fields.label: Archive Document Chats Automatically

fields.description: Days without a new message before a document chat is archived
fields.label: Archive After (Days Without Messages)

fields.description: How many chats the daily job archives per run
fields.label: Chats Archived Per Run

fields.description: Pack archived chats into a deep archive automatically once they are old enough
fields.label: Deep Archive Automatically

fields.description: Days a chat must stay in the archive before it is packed automatically
fields.label: Deep Archive After (Days)

fields.description: How many chats the daily job packs per run
fields.label: Chats Per Run

fields.description: How long unpacked content stays available after it was last opened
fields.label: Keep Unpacked Content For (Hours)

fields.description: Refuse to unpack a chat with more messages than this
fields.label: Maximum Messages To Unpack

fields.description: How many expired chats are cleaned up per run
fields.label: Cleanup Batch Size

fields.description: A packing or unpacking job stuck for longer than this is considered dead and reset
fields.label: Stuck Job Timeout (Minutes)

name: Chat Settings
